title: Introduction to Library and Information Science

items.q: All of the following belong to Information resources and formats EXCEPT
o: Secondary source
Social media
Primary source
Tertiary source
items.s: Every other option belongs to Information resources and formats. “Social media” belongs to Information and communication technology, not Information resources and formats.

items.q: The statement “the institution that collects and preserves the published output of a whole country” describes which of the following?
o: Academic library
Archive
Information centre
National library
items.s: National library is the institution that collects and preserves the published output of a whole country.

items.q: Which term is described by “a written set of principles that guides right conduct in a calling”?

Neutrality
Confidentiality

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines National library.

the institution that collects and preserves the published output of a whole country
a collection attached to a university or college to support teaching, learning and research

items.s: National library: the institution that collects and preserves the published output of a whole country. The other options describe Academic library, Cloud computing, Primary source.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Special library.

the label combining a class mark with an author mark to fix an item's shelf place
items.s: Special library: a collection serving one organisation or one subject field, such as a law firm. The other options describe Information life cycle, Monastic library, Call number.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Continuing professional development.

items.s: Continuing professional development: the ongoing learning a practitioner undertakes to keep skills current. The other options describe Information literacy, Circulation, Museology.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Selective dissemination?

a controlled list of terms showing preferred words and their relationships

items.s: Selective dissemination: the routine sending of new items to a reader whose stated interests they match. The other options describe Reference service, Thesaurus, Confidentiality.

items.q: Which term is described by “a work that lists or summarises other writings, such as a reading list or an index”?

items.q: Interlibrary loan may be defined as

material created or received in the course of an activity and kept as evidence of it
the borrowing of an item from another institution on behalf of a local reader
the deliberate capture and sharing of what staff know so an organisation does not lose it
items.s: Interlibrary loan: the borrowing of an item from another institution on behalf of a local reader. The other options describe Record, Knowledge management, Online public access catalogue.
